## 1. Blunt verdict
Byte-verified genuine mutant: `out2.srt` with bit 7 flipped at byte 72 — the comma of cue 2's end time (`00:00:09,250` → `00:00:09\xAC250`). Name decodes exactly (flip2 = bit-flip family, offset 072; matches the stride family flip2_000..136 at 8-byte steps). The lone 0xAC makes the file invalid UTF-8 → Windows-1252 fallback → '¬' lands in the ms separator → BadTimestamp damage with the other two cues surviving. Consumer `committed_corpus_survives` passes in baseline (:6113).

## 2. Notes
- Family coverage caveat: flip2 strides at 8 bytes over 000–136 of a 144-byte parent — the final 8 bytes are never stride-flipped (the seeded random loop is the only cover for that tail). Minor, recorded for the corpus as a whole.
- The generator-script absence note from the xff3_048 audit applies here too.
